name: regula
display_name: Regula — EU AI Act Compliance Scanner
description: Scan codebases for EU AI Act compliance issues. Classifies AI systems into risk tiers, maps findings to 13 compliance frameworks, generates gap assessments. 419 detection patterns across 8 languages. Fully offline, zero runtime dependencies.

install.instructions: Install via pipx: `pipx install regula-ai`. Run: `regula mcp-server` or `python3 scripts/mcp_server.py`.

tools.name: regula_check
tools.description: Scan a project directory for EU AI Act compliance issues. Returns findings with risk tier, confidence, and remediation guidance.

tools.name: regula_classify
tools.description: Classify a code snippet against EU AI Act risk tiers: Prohibited (Art 5), High-Risk (Annex III), Limited-Risk (Art 50), or Minimal-Risk.

tools.name: regula_gap
tools.description: Assess compliance gaps for Articles 9-15 of the EU AI Act. Returns a 0-100 score per article with evidence and gaps.
